  content:
    title: AI for Geoscience & Energy
    text: 'Together with Füsun Servin Tut Haklıdır, I have worked on data-driven methods for geothermal energy

      systems: fuzzy control of calcium carbonate and silica scaling (Geothermics, 2017), machine-learning

      prediction of reservoir temperatures from hydrogeochemical data (Natural Resources Research, 2020),

      deep-learning prediction of geothermal boron contamination (Environmental Earth Sciences, 2020),

      synthetic hydrogeochemical data generation with generative adversarial networks (Stanford Geothermal

      Workshop, 2025) and agent-based reinforcement learning for geochemical control (2026).


      Earlier papers explored hydrogen production from geothermal sources and from H₂S in the Black Sea.'
